proof: Twenty-three process aborts at the recovery boundaries of a real coding task, each restarted and resumed, all reaching the reference end state and worktree with one effect and nothing invented; the dispatch-boundary kill is reconciled by target inspection and retried by a model that read the report. E2E-005 in full: a dispatched destructive effect whose acknowledgement the kill lost is held as unknown with no receipt, visible to the user, settled by ReconcileToolCall, and never repeated.
audit: PARTIAL before: one boundary proven per M4 task; a tool outcome and its file changes, and a run end and its task transition, were separate transactions; a finished call re-entered on resume ran again.
limitations: Broker/provider-internal kills are covered by M4.5 and M2 tests; faults for browser/sandbox/cloud/subagent/MCP belong to their milestones; the reactive model retries an absent write as a real model would.
